Custom scroll

How to write on the scroll :

To write a text on the scroll, you need one feather and one color dye (cloth dye, leather dye or metal dye). When you have both items in your inventory, just activate this scroll and follow the instructions.

How to read the scroll :

Once a text has been written on the scroll, it can only be read. Activate it to read the text.
